summary: The exact direct-global helper-rebinding stale-cache behavior is reproduced on the prepared base and invalidated at candidate e1da223932da0393754cc3f60469506c834455d6. The candidate only partially fulfills its broader dependency-tracking claim: module/object-attribute and closure-cell helper rebinding still reuse the same cached wrapper, so the recommendation is request changes or narrow the documented scope.

tests.what_was_measured: On base acf7e67b, the same PA compile-factory signature returned the identical wrapper after direct helper rebinding; the sentinel appeared only after manual cache_clear().
At exact candidate e1da2239, all 16 candidate and related cache-key unit tests passed.
At exact candidate e1da2239, direct cdiv helper rebinding invalidated compile_pa_decode_tile and the sentinel was observed without manual cache clearing.
Direct-global rebinding invalidated, but module/object-attribute and closure-cell helper rebinding retained the same cached wrapper; two adversarial assertions failed.
On both base and candidate, real BF16 PA tile output on gfx950 was finite and matched an independent float32 PyTorch reference with max_abs_diff 0.0009765625 at unchanged rtol/atol 0.005.
The repository PA module was skipped because aiter requires Triton >=3.6.0 but the prepared environment has Triton 3.5.1+rocm7.2.0.gita272dfa8.

remaining_limitations: The candidate does not invalidate helpers referenced through module/object attributes or closure cells, despite broad referenced-helper documentation.
The historical compile_pa_decode_ps/_load_q_fragments implementation is absent from the prepared base, so the equivalent current PA tile factory was used for the same stale-wrapper mechanism.
The aiter-dependent repository PA test module could not be collected because aiter requires Triton >=3.6.0 and the pinned environment provides 3.5.1+rocm7.2.0.gita272dfa8.
No C++ or LLVM files changed, so native rebuilding was not applicable; the pinned native extension path was /opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/flydsl/_mlir.
